title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context. In cote 147, Grothendieck studies the 'structure at infinity' of the moduli spaces M_{g,ν}. Near a point of the boundary of the Deligne–Mumford compactification, the boundary divisor is a normal crossings divisor. The previous page fixes the local model (267): X = C^I with Θ = div(∏_{i∈I} z_i), where card I = n. He expects the 'elementary types' (elementary topoi or homotopy types attached to this situation) to be products, indexed by I, of the four one-variable types from (264):
- 'global' types: P (a point, dimension 0) and D* or C* (dimension 1);
- 'local' types: D (disc) and D* (punctured disc).
Accordingly I is split, by a generalized partition allowing empty classes, as I = I'_0 ⊔ I'_1 ⊔ I''_0 ⊔ I''_*.

This page.
(1) He sets d'_0 = card I'_0. This is the codimension in X of the ambient stratum R = D*_{I'_0} attached to the elementary topos (confirmed on the next page). He sets d_1 = card I'_1, the dimension of the 'soul' (âme) of the topos.
(2) The soul is by definition ∏_{i∈I'_1} C* × ∏_{i∈I∖I'_1} P = C*^{I'_1} × P^{...}. Since P is a point, the soul is a complex torus (C*)^{d_1}, homotopically the real torus T^{d_1}. As a subspace of X it is the open stratum D*_{I∖I'_1}.
(3) After a crossed-out attempt with the opposite convention, he fixes the stratification notation (269). For J ⊂ I, D_J = P^J × C^{I∖J} ⊂ X is the closed coordinate subspace {z_i = 0, i∈J}, of codimension d = card J. Inside it, D*_J = P^J × C*^{I∖J} is the corresponding open stratum (all other coordinates nonzero).
(4) (270) introduces D_d = ⨿_{card J = d} D_J and D*_d = ⨿_{card J=d} D*_J. These are the normalization of the closed codimension-d stratum Θ_d and the disjoint union of the open codimension-d strata.

Purpose. This is bookkeeping for the next page. There an elementary type is read as an immersion A = D*_{I∖I'_1} ⊂ R = D*_{I'_0}, with an intermediate stratum B, and its tubular neighbourhood V_{A,R} or deleted neighbourhood V*_{A,R}. The goal is to describe the 'topos at infinity' as glued from tubular and deleted-tubular neighbourhoods of strata of a normal crossings divisor, combinatorially indexed by partitions of I. In modern terms this is the local structure of the exit-path / stratified homotopy type, or of the Kato–Nakayama real oriented blow-up, of a normal crossings compactification.
errors: Notational inconsistency in the soul formula: the product is written over i ∈ I∖I'_1 but the underbrace says P^{I'_0}. Since P is a point this is harmless as an abstract space. As a subspace of X the correct indexing is I∖I'_1 = I'_0 ⊔ I'' (the soul is the stratum D*_{I∖I'_1}, as the next page confirms).
In (270) 'J ⊂ P(I)' should read J ∈ P(I) (or J ⊂ I).
D_d = ⨿ D_J is not a subspace of X but the normalization of the closed stratum Θ_d. This is presumably intended, but it is not stated.

The first line says 'd est la codimension' just after defining d'_0. In context the codimension of the ambient stratum is d'_0 = card I'_0, while d = card J is the codimension in (269). The notation shifts within the page.
The crossed-out first attempt used the reversed convention D_J = C*^J × P^{I∖J} and wrote X = C^J for C^I; it was corrected.

ideas.what: Stratification of the normal crossings model (C^I, ∏ z_i): closed strata D_J = {z_i=0, i∈J}, open strata D*_J, and their disjoint unions D_d, D*_d by codimension
ideas.modern_name: Canonical stratification of a (strict) normal crossings divisor; normalization of the codimension-d stratum
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard (Deligne, Théorie de Hodge II, 1971, for the NCD stratification and its use)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the 'structure at infinity' of M_{g,ν} qualitatively, not this notation

ideas.what: Elementary local types as products of four one-variable types (point, C*/D* 'global'; D, D* 'local'), indexed by a generalized 4-part partition of I, with the 'soul' (âme) a torus C*^{I'_1}
ideas.modern_name: Local models of tubular and deleted tubular neighbourhoods of strata; boundary torus fibres of the Kato–Nakayama / real oriented blow-up; exit-path data of a stratified space
ideas.usually_credited_to: Kato–Nakayama (1999) for log Betti spaces; MacPherson/Treumann/Lurie for exit paths; Nakamura and others for tangential base points on M_{g,n}
ideas.where_published: Ideas are adumbrated in Esquisse d'un programme (1984); the detailed formalism of these notes is unpublished

deep.surprise_reason: This page is a notational setup: the stratification of a coordinate normal crossings divisor and the definition of the 'soul' torus. It is mathematically standard. The surrounding project, an explicit combinatorial gluing of 'elementary topoi' at infinity for M_{g,ν}, is of historical interest. But nothing on this page goes beyond what log geometry and stratified homotopy theory later made routine.
transcription_corrections: Line 2 reads roughly 'd'_0 est la codimension (p.r. à X = C^I) du topos élémentaire envisagé, et que d_1 = card I'_1 est la dimension de l'âme du topos'. The struck words are 'qui est ici dont'.
The soul formula's left side is a crossed-out D*_{I'_1}; the right side is ∏_{i∈I'_1} C* × ∏_{i∈I∖I'_1} P with underbraces C*^{I'_1} and P^{I'_0}.
Crossed-out line: 'X = C^J' should be 'X = C^I'.
Margin note (269), approximately: 'sous-espace défini par l'annulation des z_i, i∈J, codimension d = card J'.
Left-margin scribble near the soul formula is likely 'Π dans l'espace ... envisagé ... à I', mostly struck through.
The bottom line of (270) is D*_d = ⨿_J D*_J, with the same index set {J ⊂ I, card J = d}.
